revision_reason: v5 used one trailing train-only calibration block; v6 uses reusable inner expanding OOF interval scores and fits a fresh role-by-cause calibrator inside every outer train
evidence_scope: v5 Development was read and closed; v5 Validation and sealed holdout remain unread and are unavailable to v6 fitting, calibration and selection

lineage.v5_failure: one trailing five-day role-offset block passed BUY/SELL add but did not transport cancel-ACK calibration for opener/reducing

inner_oof_role_calibration.method: generate side-specific inner expanding OOF interval hazards once; inside each outer train use only inner-test days contained in that train to fit role-by-cause Platt maps; refit the base hazard on the full outer train; apply both only to the subsequent outer test
inner_oof_role_calibration.calibrator: weighted logit intercept plus positive slope on inner-OOF raw binary hazard, fitted with stable two-parameter L-BFGS and log-slope ridge
inner_oof_role_calibration.global_inner_oof_reuse_rule: an inner-test score may enter an outer calibrator only when its day is in that outer train; its inner fit and embargo days are necessarily earlier
inner_oof_role_calibration.competing_probability_normalization: after independent role/cause calibration, preserve cause ratio and cap total interval hazard below one
inner_oof_role_calibration.fallback: none; missing role/cause support or non-positive calibration slope fails closed

development_fit.pre_development_smoke_revision: the initial mechanics smoke exposed sklearn weighted-logit overflow warnings; before any formal Development outcome was read, the same two-parameter estimand was moved to a stable log-slope optimizer and the implementation hash was re-frozen
